hermitcrab.reviewed_by: Codex: direct final baseline/candidate, native full-cycle motion, water and icon inspection; not user sign-off
hermitcrab.notes: 45 functional authored joints versus baseline 67 palette entries, of which 37 weighted and 29 animated weighted. Six 3-joint walking chains, four shell-carrying legs, two unequal articulated pincers, eye stalks, antennae. Own stepped whorl shell and ochre cuticle. Full idle/walk/die retained; death is asset capability outside runtime locomotion states. Rigid weights appropriate for exoskeleton. Latest revision shortens pincers and restores dominant shell mass.
